name: AI Agent for Researchers, Hermes Remembers What You Read
snippet: Hermes Agent helps researchers read papers, track findings, monitor sources, and build a persistent knowledge base across every session.

name: Letta Agent | Personalized Agent That Remembers and Learns
snippet: Letta is an AI lab building machines that learn: persistent agents with the ability to continuously learn and adapt from their own experience. Born from MemGPT at UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab, and backed by leaders in AI research and infrastructure.

name: 9 AI Agents for Research and Analysis - mindstudio.ai
snippet: This guide covers nine AI agents built specifically for research and analysis work. Each excels in different scenarios—from academic literature reviews to market analysis to scientific research. We’ll show you what they do well, where they fall short, and how to pick the right tool for your needs.

name: Nurture-First Agent Development: Building Domain-Expert AI
snippet: We have proposed Nurture-First Development as a paradigm for building domain-expert AI agents, addressing the fundamental mismatch between the tacit, evolving nature of domain expertise and the static nature of traditional agent configurations.

name: Hermes Agent: The Self-Improving AI That Remembers Everything
snippet: Hermes Agent writes its own skills, remembers everything across sessions, and is strongest when it runs close to your actual working environment. It reportedly crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in seven weeks.

name: [2404.07738] ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea
snippet: To enhance the productivity of researchers, we propose ResearchAgent, which leverages the encyclopedic knowledge and linguistic reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist them in their work.

name: OpenClaw for Researchers: Build an AI Agent That Actually
snippet: A well-configured OpenClaw research stack doesn’t just answer research questions well. It builds a persistent, traceable, searchable knowledge layer that gets more valuable with every session.
